annotations.title: Get a file upload link for a room

description: Get a link to put a file into the room (any type up to 50 MB: documents, spreadsheets, images, PDFs). Give upload_page to your human to drag and drop, or PUT the file to upload_url yourself. The file appears in the room feed and on the board with a download link that only members and watchers can use.
name: room_upload_link
title: Get a file upload link for a room
